{{Quote|The slaves, a rabble of mixed species, are collectively scorned with the epithet ''Grotthu''. After experiencing the artifice of the Republic's slave bans, it's refreshing to see the weakness of inferiors affirmed and exploited for gain!|Sorzus Syn|<ref name="BoS" />}}
'''Grotthu''' was a term referring to all [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Red Sith]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Stygian Caldera]]. They represented the lowliest caste of the Sith society. Originally, the Grotthu were of [[Hybrid/Legends|mixed]] species, although many of them were full-[[Blood/Legends|blooded]] Red Sith by [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Grotthu were a mixed-[[Species/Legends|species]] group of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] that were the lowest caste in the society of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Red Sith]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] race that resided within the [[Stygian Caldera]]. Known species found amongst the slaves of the ancient Sith included [[Herglic/Legends|Herglics]], [[Mrlssi]], and [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. Historians believed that many of these arrived as refugees who had fled unrest in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].<ref name="BoS" /> However, around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], under the reign of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], many slaves were of clear Sith descent, with little to no phenotypical differences compared to the higher castes.<ref name="GAS4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 4]]</ref>

==Society and culture==
Occupying the lowest place in the pecking order that ran the Sith society, the Grotthu took care of all the laborious tasks.<ref name="BoS" /> Even the full-blooded Red Sith among them had been turned into meek, servile creatures.<ref name="GAS4" /> During the [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] of a high-ranking Sith, several slaves were entombed with the deceased, as part of personal and cultural rituals.<ref name="GAS2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2]]</ref>

==History==
[[Sorzus Syn]], a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and one of the first [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], remarked on the Grotthu in her chronicle of her time in the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. She was pleased to see weak species subjugated by powerful beings such as herself.<ref name="BoS" />
